name: Supersonic
purpose: Guitarix model of a modern high-gain amp: tight, aggressive distortion with gain, bass and treble. The high-gain guitar sound for rock and metal. Follow with gx_ultracab.

params.name: Gain
params.ai_hint: Distortion amount. 0.1-0.25 crunch, 0.3-0.6 high gain, above 0.7 saturated and compressed.

params.name: Bass
params.ai_hint: 0.5 is neutral. Lower to tighten palm mutes, raise for weight.

params.name: Treble
params.ai_hint: 0.5 is neutral. Lower to tame fizz, raise for bite.

params.name: Volume
params.ai_hint: Output level after the amp. Adjust to match the other guitar tones; 0.25 is a sensible starting level.

notes: Port names and ranges come from the Guitarix plug-in (all 0..1); defaults are the plug-in's own.
CPU: under 2% of one core at 48 kHz on Plugsalot's 2-core build machine (plugin/tests/TestMain.cpp); 1 point per 2%, minimum 1.
